company.shortDescription: WOW DECOR is an interior design and fit-out company that provides custom furniture, home renovation, and interior décor services.
company.description: WOW DECOR is a UAE-based interior design and fit-out company that offers residential and commercial interior solutions, including space planning, custom furniture, renovation, décor, and turnkey fit-out services. The company works on projects such as villas, apartments, offices, retail spaces, and hospitality interiors, combining design consultation with project execution and furnishing services. Its offerings also include bespoke woodwork, lighting, wall treatments, and home styling aimed at functional and aesthetic interior enhancement.
